name: uniprot-mcp-server
description: Protein research over UniProtKB: search by function, fetch curated records, map IDs, proteomes.

UNIPROT_BASE_URL.title: UniProt REST base URL
UNIPROT_BASE_URL.description: Override for a private mirror or testing. Leave blank for https://rest.uniprot.org.

UNIPROT_TIMEOUT_MS.title: Request timeout (ms)
UNIPROT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Per-request HTTP timeout in milliseconds. Leave blank for 30000.

UNIPROT_ID_MAPPING_BUDGET_MS.title: ID-mapping poll budget (ms)
UNIPROT_ID_MAPPING_BUDGET_MS.description: Milliseconds uniprot_map_ids polls a mapping job inline before returning a resumable ticket; keep it below the request timeout. Leave blank for 8000.

UNIPROT_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE.title: Default page size
UNIPROT_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE.description: Page size (1–500) for search and proteome protein listing when the caller leaves size unset. Leave blank for 25.

UNIPROT_CLAMP_LIMITS.title: Serve over-the-cap inputs
UNIPROT_CLAMP_LIMITS.description: Serve an over-the-cap size at 500 with a notice, accept any section_limit, and accept up to 500 accessions on uniprot_get_entry (the first 20 distinct fetched, the rest deferred). Set false to reject them instead (size and section_limit above 500, more than 20 accessions). Leave blank for true.
